title: Add OAuth provider config
body:
Load client id/secret + issuer from env and expose a typed config.

Acceptance: invalid config fails fast at startup with a clear error.

title: Add session middleware
body:
Verify the session cookie on each request and attach the user.

Acceptance: unauthenticated requests to protected routes get 401.

title: Add /login and /callback routes
body:
Start the OAuth flow and handle the redirect; set the session cookie.

Acceptance: a full login round-trip lands an authenticated session.
